podcast.body: This song was recorded in 1980 and released in 1981 on the album *The Nature of the Beast*. It made it to number 21 on the Billboard Hot 100 in April. The lyrics lament a love that was not meant to be, expressing the pain of broken hearts that don't always mend and the hesitation to try love again. "It made it to number 21 on the Billboard Hot 100 in April."

podcast.body: This song's video was the first Canadian video ever shown on MTV, appearing as the 14th video broadcast on the channel. Its inclusion marked an early milestone for Canadian artists on the newly launched 24-hour music video channel. "The first Canadian video was just between you and me from April 1, which showed up as the 14th video."
